hypothesis: Reusing exported MediaStore content URIs with openOutputStream(uri,'wt') can destroy a previously published log/summary if a later write is interrupted.
negative_controls: Reject destructive openOutputStream(logExport, wt) / openOutputStream(summaryExport, wt)
Keep old export URIs until both new writeMedia calls succeed
Rollback first newly published log if second summary write fails
Warn if retiring complete old MediaStore URI fails
budget: source-only CI with compile and JDK tests; no full Unity, APK, Android device
observed_result: Paired non-destructive re-export fix db261619; regression tests f2609b07; automatically triggered source workflows in-progress/pending at checkpoint.
limitations: MediaStore cannot make two distinct public URIs appear in a single atomic operation; rollback closes the failure window but does not guarantee zero transient visibility.
Old-file retirement failure can leave two valid copies; user is warned.
New private in-memory/current activity URIs are not persisted across process restarts.
No actual device fault injection or full game acceptance.
